notes: Concord Mk2: Mk1 plus a second (outer) ring whose 8 amber lamps chase around it, and a bigger, hotter core. Damaged: the upper-right capacitor is split open and sparking, the left pipe has slipped its flange and weeps, the outer ring has a chipped gap, the core stutters. Disabled: dead core, the casing split corner to corner, the capacitor blown out.
